issue.title: ledger-tools unblocked-glyph tests build the daily path from the wall clock while fixtures freeze 2026-10-09

task_type_fields.node_id: scripts/test-ledger-tools-unblocked-glyph.cjs::Live Preview places one glyph after each unblocked link
task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The four failures in test-ledger-tools-unblocked-glyph.cjs reproduce identically at the pre-epic base 4193a19 and at master 1abde2f. The cause: the module builds `const DAILY = todayDailyPath(new Date(), {})` from the wall clock (line 179), while every fixture freezes `TODAY = new Date(2026, 9, 9, 12)` (line 188). Since 2026-10-09 the decorated daily path no longer matches the frozen day, so `buildUnblockedGlyphDecorations` finds 0 links instead of 1. bob-cli-6u.10, 6u.12, 6u.13, 6u.14 and 6u.15 each saw this on a clean base. Fix: derive DAILY from the frozen TODAY, or inject the clock.
